newsitem.title: PHILIPPINES: Asea Brown Boveri, Marubeni win Manila rail deal.
newsitem.headline: Asea Brown Boveri, Marubeni win Manila rail deal.

text.p: A joint venture between Asea Brown Boveri and Marubeni Corp has won a 2.77 billion peso contract to expand Manila's light rail system, Transportation Undersecretary Primitivo Cal said on Wednesday.
The two outbid three other groups, namely: GEC Alsthom ; a consortium of Siemens AG, Mitsui and Kawasaki ; and a joint venture between Mitsubishi Corp and Construcciones y Auxiliar De Ferrocarriles.
The project involved the expansion of the existing line of the light railway transit on Taft Avenue in Manila. The capacity will be increased by 50 percent from the existing 27,000 passengers a day.
Cal said the project is expected to be finished in 20 to 24 months.

He said the results of the bid evaluation were approved by the board of the Light Railwy Transit Authority last month. The bid results had also been submitted to the Overseas Economic Cooperation Fund which will provide the bulk of the financing under the 19th Yen loan package.
